coverage_scope: Saved GND zone filled polygons only; pads, tracks and via copper are included only in the separate connectivity graph.
limitations: Not a 100-percent physical coverage or manufacturability certification. Saved KiCad fill contours are already tessellated; their original curve approximation error cannot be reconstructed from this saved file.

The analytical circular band is also polygonized. Raw missing area is reported; boundary-buffer comparison is diagnostic only and can conceal real narrow gaps, so it never turns a raw failure into a pass.
Radial widths are sampled. An unsampled narrow angular gap may be missed by width sampling, although it can still appear in the area difference.
The default inner-layer band is 0.23 mm wide, not 0.25 mm. The 0.25 mm value is an initial design direction; outer-anchored width is also reported.
Connectivity uses copper envelopes and a stated contact tolerance. Thermal-spoke detail depends on the saved fill; run refill and KiCad DRC before treating a candidate as electrically verified.

connectivity_graph.method: Same-net filled zones, tracks/arcs, pad copper and via annuli are unioned on each layer; plated item identities bridge layers. Reachability starts at the named GND pad. This geometric graph does not replace KiCad connectivity/DRC or physical testing.
